selectors.exact: **Hibi runs no verifiers and no resolvers.** Its only network call is the judge API. Its only subprocess is `git`. It writes nothing into documents except the tombstone `archive` leaves at an archived document's path, and the instruction line `init --instructions` appends to the named file. Before it writes the tombstone, `archive` copies the document to `archive/<path>` under the repository root. Apart from those writes and the store under `.claims/`, it only reads. An agent collects evidence and submits it.
